description: The shadow alone: a blurred, offset copy of the glyphs.

florui.css: .scene { position: relative; width: 160px; height: 70px; background-color: #ffffff; } .t { position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 10px; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; color: transparent; text-shadow: 2px 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); }

classification.reason: A blurred shadow with the text itself transparent matches Chromium to within 18 levels of 255 everywhere (none beyond the 24 allowed): the blur radius is twice the Gaussian's standard deviation in both, so the spread and the offset agree. Measured against desktop Chrome; geometry an exact match.
